description: Physical and environmental protection policy and procedures are not developed, documented, and maintained.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing physical security policy documentation, outdated procedures, lack of policy dissemination evidence, absence of defined roles and responsibilities for physical security, and missing review/update schedules.
